provenance_candidate_lines: This is a Question Answering (QA) dataset for Bengali, curated from the [SQuAD 2.0](), [TyDI-QA]() datasets and using the state-of-the-art English to Bengali translation model introduced **[here](https://aclanthology.org/2020.emnlp-main.207/).**

For the training set, we translated the complete [SQuAD 2.0](https://aclanthology.org/N18-1101/) dataset using the English to Bangla translation model introduced [here](https://aclanthology.org/2020.emnlp-main.207/).
